enrichment.coordinate_definition: world point = camera_origin + camera_z * world_ray; world_ray is rotated [(u-Cx)/Fx,(v-Cy)/Fy,1], not normalized
enrichment.surface_normal_definition: existing surface_normal_world is normalized actual gradF, flipped to face camera; guide_normal_world is n; gradF_world retains the local F orientation
enrichment.curvature_definition: existing curvature is n^T Hess(log response_sum) n; not mean/Gaussian surface curvature
enrichment.response_definition: sum filtered_opacity_i * exp(-0.5 Mahalanobis_sq_i); dimensionless unnormalized local response, not calibrated occupancy/visibility
enrichment.absolute_eigen_gap_definition: lambda1-lambda2 of sum pi_i gamma_i n_i n_i^T; existing relative gap divides by trace
